result:
The glow pools shipped earlier as v34.76, but the 4K frame-time numbers and glow pictures are still missing. I added a line about it to `alarms.md`.

- **What shipped:** the forge, forged guns and burning, shocked or frozen bodies now cast coloured light into the light map. Each also gets one cached halo drawn before the fog. The POST FX row is now on the quality ladder and turns off when a busy frame sheds it. Its hint now reads "Glow pools from the forge, fire and shock. Off runs faster."
- **What the new check covers:** halo and pool counts with post on, off, intensity 0 and at ladder rung 2. It also requires 8 halos to cost under 1 ms per call.
- **What is missing:** no camera screen stages the forge or a burning body, so the before and after pictures only show that nothing else moved. The 4K two-window frame time has not been measured either. That needs a camera screen with a glow source and a `tools/fuzz.ps1` run at 4K on a scratch port. Neither is on my command list.
- **Not verified:** the pixel and vector looks of the glow itself have not been seen.

TASK WAITING: coordinator needs a uishots screen that stages the forge or a burning body, plus a 4K two-window perf run, for 127-gfx-glow-pools.
